title: La Mer des Chagrins — créations complémentaires de la bible

notes: The supplied primary evidence describes a limited set of traits and objects; unspecified visual details remain project interpretations.

assets.sourceStatus: project interpretation; no canonical face certified
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE individual transparent-background full-body character sprite for a 2D side-view adventure.
Reference image 1 is the project's established Alan Decker identity and original outfit. Reference images 2 and 3 are the two existing walking contacts. Maintain the same face, wavy short dark hair, stubble, brown weathered field jacket, charcoal shirt, dark cargo trousers, brown belt, diagonal satchel strap, hip satchel, heavy boots, material detail, lighting, viewpoint and scale.
Create the missing PASSING pose between the two contacts, facing screen-right. The torso remains upright at the same height, arms relaxed and close to the body with a modest counter-swing, empty hands. This is a natural restrained walk, not a run.
Composition: one complete character centered in a 1024x1536 portrait canvas with transparent margins, full hair and boot soles visible. The supporting boot meets a horizontal ground line near the bottom. Match the references' realistic illustrated sprite finish.
Background: genuine RGBA transparency, isolated character only, no floor, shadow, backdrop, glow, labels, text, duplicate character or sprite sheet. Do not redesign the face, costume, anatomical side of the bag or body proportions.
Pose A: the leg NEAREST the viewer supports his weight almost vertically beneath the pelvis with its whole boot on the ground; the FAR leg bends at the knee and passes forward closely beside it, its boot raised just above the ground. The two thighs are close at the passing position. Do not spread the legs into another contact pose.
